summary: 1. Bug (medium-low, proven) vs `:414`: covered-line identity hashes the wrong line when a source file contains a Python-only line separator (`\x0b`, `\x0c`, `\x85`, `\x1c`–`\x1e`). The scanner counts breaks tsc-aligned (LF/CR/CRLF/U+2028/U+2029) but `maskedLines` splits with `pySplitLines`, which breaks on six extra characters. Repro'd end-to-end: an approved switch-off survives an edit to the line it suppresses (check stays `clear`), breaking D8. Fix: make the split set and `breakLen` set identical, keeping the reported line on the tsc-aligned set.
